description: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka - Implementing standards No. SLCAIS - 053- Requirements for operation of pilotless aircraft (unmanned aerial vehicles/remotely piloted aircrafts)
categorisation: This gazette content establishes regulatory requirements for operating unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010. It creates new implementing standards, sets operational rules, mass limits, flight clearance requirements, and identification protocols. This constitutes a regulatory framework issued by the Civil Aviation Authority, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
